Author: Mangesh S. Patil
Bench: Mangesh S. Patil
 913 aba 608 21.odt
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
 913 Anticipatory Bail Application No.608 Of 2021
 Mohammad Ibrahim Mohammad Hakimuddin Shaikh
 Versus

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The State Of Maharashtra And Another
 ...

Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Deshpande Chaitanya C.
 App for Respondent : Mr. V. S. Badakh.

Coram : Mangesh S. Patil, J.
 Date : 22.06.2021.
Learned A.P.P. waives service and seeks time.

3. In the event of the arrest of the applicant, till the next date, in connection with Crime No.
179/2021, registered with Dhule Taluka Police Station, District Dhule, for the offences punishable under Section 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 26(2) (iv), 30(2) (a)
and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, he shall be released on bail on his executing personal recognizance for an amount of Rs. 15,000/- (Rs. Fifteen Thousand only) and furnishing a solvent surety in the like amount subject to following conditions :
(a) He shall attend the concerned Police Station as and when called by the Investigating Officer and shall cooperate him.

entities.text: Dhule Taluka Police Station, District Dhule
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: (b) He shall not tamper the evidence or influence the witnesses.

(MANGESH S. PATIL, J.) mkd/-
